label: MEF
notes: Mouse embryonic fibroblast starting population (trajectory root). PRIMARY ASSIGNMENT: source sample identity / abs_day == 0. This gene set is an AUXILIARY fibroblast/mesenchymal support score only; do not use it as the primary classifier.

label: epithelial_like
notes: Mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition (MET) milestone; canonical epithelial markers.

label: intermediate_plastic
notes: Intermediate plastic / diapause-like milestone (Chen et al. 2023 report a developmentally diapause-like state during FCR); markers are early-pluripotency / 2C-like / diapause-associated factors.

label: iPSC
notes: Naive pluripotency / iPSC endpoint; canonical core pluripotency network.
